id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

selectedAssetId.description:
The current asset that is "selected" by the user.
This field informs the side panel to display the details of the selected asset.

selectedAlertId.description:
The current alert that has been selected by the user.
This field updates the side panel to show the alert detail panel

selectedWorkOrderId.description:
The current work order that has been selected by the user.
This field updates the side panel to show the work order detail panel

selectedPartId.description:
The current similar spare part selected by the user
This field is required to show the add spare part modal

sidePanelToShow.description: The id of the specific {@link UiSdlSidePanel} component to show.

isFilterPanelOpen.description: Current open/closed state of the asset map filter panel

submittedFilterSpec.description: The data spec for the asset map.
